title: Xdrip variant crash
symptom: When going to settings, alarm and alerts, glucose level alert list, xdrip crashes and restarts. Same behavior on settings for missed reading alert. Also, recent xdrip variants don't have separate names like they have before; both xdrip on the phone have the same name, just 'xdrip'.
cause: Something wrong with the automated build process.
fix: Updated binaries provided in release 2021.10.13-variants resolved the issue.
evidence_quote: Try these updated binaries. I think this should resolve the issue: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2021.10.13-variants
